scripts.dev: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:Path = \"$env:windir\\System32;\" + $env:Path; $env:NPM_CONFIG_CACHE = (Join-Path (Get-Location) '.npm-cache'); concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green 'python backend/app/main.py' 'npm --prefix frontend run dev'"
